paragraphs.text: Morphs the sidebar whale and sweeps a marquee across DEEPSEEK HARNESS while a session generates, mar
ks conversation titles with a whale icon, plays a whale-dive animation while a conversation loads, a
nd draws a light rotating rainbow ring around any focused composer.
# Harness Brand Motion

Harness Client plugin that animates the Harness brand: the sidebar logo while a
session is generatin

g, and a whale mark that dives before the conversation
title while that conversation is loading (hid
den once it is ready).
## Behavior

- **Idle** — both sidebar occupants draw the same artwork the official brand
draws (the whale path a

nd the `deepseek` + `HARNESS` wordmark, same geometry,
same `currentColor` / inverted label colors),

so the sidebar looks unchanged
when nothing is running.
- **Generating** — while any Harness sessio

n reports `running: true` in the
`useSessionStatus` snapshot:
- the **whale morphs** between two def

ormed body poses (non-uniform squash
plus a body bow, animated through the SVG `d` attribute) with a

EPSEEK HARNESS` letters,
clipped to the glyph outlines.
- The mark's own SVG viewport carries transp

arent padding and the morph is
anchored at the mark's left edge, so every deformed frame stays fully

visible
inside the 24 px logo box instead of being clipped by its container.
- `prefers-reduced-mot

ion: reduce` freezes the morph and the sweep, keeping
only the slow glow.
- **Conversation title mar

k** — the conversation header's leading seat draws a
small whale before the session title whenever t

e → nothing is rendered, so the title returns to its normal position.
- **Composer rainbow** — a hid

den marker is rendered inside every Session
composer card (new session and existing conversations).

While that card
contains a focused editor, CSS draws a rotating, light conic-gradient rainbow
ring a

round the card (outside its rounded border), masked to a 2 px stroke.
`prefers-reduced-motion: reduc

e` freezes the rotation.
- Each occupant is wrapped in an error boundary; a rendering failure falls

back
to static artwork instead of blanking the brand row.
## Extension points
| Slot | Occupant |

| `sidebar.brand.mark` | animated whale mark (`priority: -10`) |
| `sidebar.brand.name` | `deepseek

HARNESS` wordmark with marquee (`priority: -10`) |
| `conversation.header.leading` | whale mark: div

es while loading, swims while generating, hidden when idle |
| `conversation.input.overlay` | hidden
`composer-rainbow-mark` marker for the focused composer rainbow |

No DOM is written outside the style tag that the plugin installs and removes
with its own effect.
## Background scan scheduler

Every periodic refresh (scroll affordance, account avatar mirror, wait-countdown
cards, error chips,

composer toolbar safety net, connection-pill placement, bot
roster pull) registers with **one** sch
eduler instead of owning a `setInterval`:

a pass that found nothing backs off geometrically (×1.6, capped) and snaps
back to its nominal cade

nce the moment the DOM actually changed;
- at most two jobs run per wake-up, so no single pass becom

r`; when nothing mutated, the
dirty-only jobs skip their DOM scan entirely.

The cadence is user-selectable in the plugin's gear panel under **性能 → 后台扫描频率**:
`省电` (2.5× slower),

`平衡` (default) and `灵敏` (2× faster). The choice is stored
with the plugin's other preferences in `l

t) and `灵敏` (2× faster). The choice is stored
with the plugin's other preferences in `localStorage`.

Three timers stay local because they are short-lived and state-bound: the
per-card countdown tick (1

s, only while a countdown card exists), and the
session-switch overlay's measure/state loops (1 s /
400 ms, at most 4 s).
## Files
| File | Role |

| `index.js` | Host half (no host behavior) |
| `client.js` | Client module: styles, copied artwork,

morph, slot occupants |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the bundle row |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin

Manager title and description |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin inventory icon |
## Install

Install the package directory with the Plugin Manager `install_bundle` action
(`/Users/aoao/Document

s/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/sidebar-logo-animation`),
then toggle it in Settings → Plugins.
